title: Senior Analyst - Credit and Collections
description:
As the Senior Analyst – Credit and Collections, you will be responsible for managing the accounts receivable for a portfolio of customers, including collecting payments, maintaining records, and evaluating credit information to minimize credit risk. You will be responsible for contacting customers to confirm outstanding payments, obtain payment commitments and recommending solutions to remove impediments for future customer payments within the agreed payment terms. You will also mentor others with lower-level positions in Financial Services.

**Responsibilities:**

* Reviews past due invoices and makes a high-volume of collection contacts via phone, e-mail, or customer portals.
* Works with the customer to determine root cause of dispute for unpaid or short-paid invoices. Identifies and documents detailed reason and recommends corrective action to resolve current and future disputes.
* Performs customer account reconciliations, including research of unapplied cash, and credits and unearned discounts. Recommends actions for resolution and avoidance of future reconciling issues.
* Evaluates collectability of unearned cash discounts, finance charges, small dollar invoices, etc. and performs write-offs of uncollectable amounts within their level of authority. Reviews and approves write-offs escalated from Analysts and further escalates with recommendations to next level of approval authority based on materiality.
* Obtains appropriate credit information to rate credit worthiness of new and existing accounts within assigned portfolio. Reviews and approves credit limits escalated from Analysts and further escalates with recommendations to next level of approval authority based on materiality.
* Works cross-functionally with sales, operations, finance, contract administration, and customer master administration teams to gather and review documents, including purchase orders, credit applications, and loads into contract tracking tool with recommendation of approval decision by financial services management and partners.
Reviews orders on credit hold by assessing credit worthiness of customers, including financial ratings, open invoices, in-process payments, and backlog. Releases orders or escalates to supervisor with recommendation for continued credit hold actions.  

**Qualifications:**

* Associates’ Degree (U.S.)/College Diploma (Canada) - Accounting, finance, supply chain or business required; Bachelors’ Degree preferred
* Licenses/Certificates/Designations - NACM or similar preferred
* 3 years of accounts receivable, accounting, finance, supply chain or general business
* 3 years of commercial, business to business, credit and collection experience in a high-volume environment
* 3 years of working with trade credit and other third parties (e.g., D&B, Experian, Equifax, NACM, CreditSafe) to obtain credit information
* Knowledge of computer system applications: HighRadius, Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Excel, and Word, and familiarity with an ERP platform (e.g., Oracle, DAX, AS400 etc.) required.
* High level of Excel knowledge preferred including pivot tables, vlookups, etc.
* Strong written, oral communication and interpersonal skills with a positive disposition.
* Reliable with strong organizational skills and solution-oriented philosophy.
* Ability to work independently as well as in a team environment.
* Strong attention to detail with a passion for accuracy.
* Willingness to accommodate temporary working hour changes as required by workflow.
* Ability to prioritize tasks and demonstrate a willingness to accept new challenges.
* Ability to work with all levels of management to accomplish goals and objectives.
* Willingness to travel on a limited basis (1-3 trips per year)

title: Finance & Accounting Lead - Business Central Setup, AI Agents & Latvian Tax
description:
**Location:** Fully remote
  
**Company:** Latvia-based startup
  
**Compensation:** We operate on a startup budget. Compensation will be discussed transparently during the hiring process and paid monthly in USD.
  
**Engagement type:** Full-time  
**Working hours:** Flexible

**About Us**

We are a Latvia-based startup building a finance function that combines accurate accounting, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central and practical AI automation.

We are looking for a finance professional who can personally manage our accounting, configure the systems supporting it and use AI agents to carry out the work more efficiently.

**Job Description**

You will personally perform and take ownership of our accounting and financial operations, using AI agents to support your work. Your responsibilities will cover daily bookkeeping, reconciliations, closing, financial reporting, cash planning and applicable Latvian tax reporting.

You will personally carry out the complete migration from QuickBooks to Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, using AI agents to support your work. You will be responsible for all implementation tasks, from planning and data preparation through configuration, import, validation and go-live. No external implementation partners will be involved. As part of preparing and importing the data, you will review the complete accounting records for the past five years, identify gaps and errors, and reconcile the migrated data to the source records. You must be comfortable both doing the accounting and setting up the accounting system.

AI agents will assist with document processing, transaction preparation, matching, reconciliation and reporting. You will define their tasks, supervise their execution, investigate exceptions and verify their outputs. You remain responsible for the accuracy and completeness of the work.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Perform day-to-day bookkeeping, accounts payable and receivable, invoicing, expense accounting and bank reconciliations.
* Complete month-end and year-end closing, balance sheet reconciliations, accruals and supporting documentation.
* Set up, configure and maintain Business Central, including the chart of accounts, posting groups, dimensions, VAT setup, bank accounts, accounting periods and relevant financial workflows.
* Personally execute the complete migration from QuickBooks to Business Central, including data extraction, account and tax mapping, cleansing, system configuration, trial imports, reconciliation and go-live. Review all accounting records for the past five years during migration preparation and import, investigate missing or incorrect entries, document corrections and preserve supporting documents and a traceable audit trail.
* Prepare and manage applicable Latvian tax and statutory reporting, including VAT, corporate income tax, payroll-related obligations and VID/EDS processes.
* Handle international customers, suppliers, contractors, foreign currencies and cross-border transactions.
* Manage cash-flow forecasts, budgets, runway monitoring and management reporting.
* Prepare payments and administer payroll and contractor payments within agreed approval controls.
* Configure, instruct and supervise AI agents supporting accounting workflows; improve their performance through clear instructions, reliable source data and systematic verification.
* Maintain traceability from original documents to accounting entries, resolve exceptions and protect confidential financial information.
* Identify practical opportunities to reduce costs, improve financial controls and apply lawful tax efficiencies.

**Required Qualifications**

* Proven experience personally performing the full accounting cycle for companies in one or more European countries.
* Practical experience with accounting, taxation and statutory reporting in one or more European countries, and the ability to apply and verify Latvian requirements. Direct Latvian accounting and VID/EDS experience is an advantage.
* Hands-on experience independently setting up and configuring Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central for real accounting operations, with the ability to personally execute a complete accounting-system migration.
* The ability to translate business requirements into appropriate accounting configuration and verify that postings, reconciliations and reports work correctly.
* Practical experience using AI agents or AI-supported automation in finance or accounting, including supervising outputs and handling errors.
* Strong spreadsheet and analytical skills, with the ability to investigate incomplete records and reconcile inconsistent data.
* Independent working habits, ownership of deadlines and clear communication with the founder.
* Professional working proficiency in English and the ability to work effectively with Latvian-language financial documents and reporting requirements.
* A relevant accounting or finance qualification, or equivalent substantial practical experience.

**Especially Valuable Experience**

* Building or improving the accounting function of a startup or small international business.
* QuickBooks to Business Central migrations, Business Central implementations and comprehensive reviews and correction of historical accounting records.
* Configuring integrations with banks, payment platforms, document systems and Microsoft 365.
* Power Automate, Power BI, APIs or comparable tools used in practical finance workflows.
* Accounting for digital services, subscriptions and international contractor relationships.
* Preparing financial information for funding discussions or due diligence.

**What We Offer**

* A fully remote role with direct collaboration with the founder.
* Responsibility for both the accounting work and the systems supporting it.
* The opportunity to shape how Business Central and AI agents work together in a startup.
* A practical environment where reliable execution, sensible automation and cost awareness matter.

**Remote Working Arrangement**

You will organize your work independently, communicate progress clearly and meet agreed accounting and reporting deadlines. Financial systems and confidential information must be handled securely.

This is a full-time role with flexible working hours. You will organize your schedule around agreed accounting and reporting deadlines.

**How to Apply**

Please submit your CV and briefly describe:

* The European countries in which you have personally handled accounting and tax reporting, and your specific responsibilities.
* A Business Central implementation or accounting-system migration you personally executed, including the setup, data migration and validation you performed yourself, and any experience with QuickBooks or historical accounting reviews.
* How you have used AI agents or automation to perform accounting work and verify its accuracy.

Use anonymized examples and clearly distinguish your own work from work delivered by others.
